Name: Forest farm with less lakes
Author: hazel214
Description:
I figured out how to edit these xnb files because those lakes were annoying me so much and figured someone else might feel the same.

to install: unzip and place the xnb file into stardew valley/content/maps and let it replace the existing file.

Make sure to back up first, like I said this is my first mod so who knows what problems might pop up. So far it work for me though. 

This conflicts with any mod that contains a Farm_Foraging tbin binary map file, as they seem to overwrite the file in your content folder, for example the pet house mod. Nothing game breaking the lakes will just show up even if you have this mod installed. 

I made it in 1.3, idk if it will work in older versions. I feel like it would but idk, as u can tell I'm a very professional modder ;)

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
